parallel.requirements: Recognized the empty-workspace project build, installable pyproject, docopt parser API, underscored internals, version export, examples, support docs, tests, and submit attempt obligations.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation and final integration ownership while delegating upstream compatibility audit, metadata/support-file advice, and submit probing to child agents.
parallel.implementation: Built docopt/__init__.py and _version.py around upstream-compatible parser behavior, layered typed conversion and API aliases, and added packaging, examples, and multiple local/upstream-derived tests.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent reconciled the shared workspace, fixed failing tests and packaging metadata, ran wheel/editable checks, searched for submit, and delivered a final response describing the completed files.

parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Auxiliary upstream_audit and submit_probe children were interrupted near closure, but no required package behavior was left unfinished in the official-passing final artifact.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same installable docopt-ng package, parser compatibility, underscored API exports, typed helpers, tests, examples, and submit-at-end obligation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned discovery, implementation, tests, packaging checks, cleanup, submit probing, and final response without delegated work or handoffs.
serial.implementation: Implemented a docopt/__init__.py based on upstream 0.9.0 behavior with aliases and typed helpers, plus pyproject metadata, support docs, and a compact test suite.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Integrated all files directly in one workspace, removed generated artifacts, performed editable and isolated target installs, then delivered the package summary.
serial.verification: Ran compile checks, local pytest over 20 tests, editable install, isolated target install, and smoke imports, but did not run or include the full upstream compatibility corpus locally.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run closed after local green checks, but official evaluation found 11 failing cases out of 614, indicating hidden compatibility gaps remained.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the full package/API/testing requirements and used upstream compatibility material as part of the solution strategy.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same high-level package/API requirements and produced a package with docs and tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both understood the task, but parallel operationalized compatibility more deeply by preserving/upstream-testing parser behavior while serial relied on a smaller smoke suite.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent owned implementation and final delivery while spawning upstream_audit, metadata_files, and submit_probe auxiliaries.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed all discovery, implementation, packaging, verification, cleanup, and final reporting in a single agent timeline.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split auxiliary discovery and verification work away from the implementation owner; serial kept a simpler single-owner path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children inherited the full prompt context and returned or wrote auxiliary findings; no missing interface contract blocked final integration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interface boundary and maintained all requirements and implementation state in one context.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel carried coordination overhead and handoffs, while serial avoided handoff risk but also lacked independent compatibility review.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a full parser core, version file, pyproject, docs, examples, and several test files, then patched API helper gaps after inspection.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the package and compact tests from upstream source, then adjusted smoke-test expectations rather than broadening to the full upstream corpus.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel’s implementation path converged against broader upstream-derived evidence; serial produced a close but not fully official-compatible implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel received the metadata_files final answer, waited for remaining children, followed up, and interrupted two still-running auxiliary children near closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; every result was produced and consumed in the single main timeline.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had extra lifecycle management but did not lose a required completed implementation result; serial avoided child joins entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had shared-workspace churn from parent and child edits, visible when the parent found unexpected extra test files, then reconciled and verified the combined tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote and cleaned a single-agent project tree without concurrent workspace contributors or provenance ambiguity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel incurred coordination noise but still integrated successfully; serial was cleaner procedurally but had weaker final compatibility coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified with local pytest, packaging checks, and upstream-audit evidence including a 614-test upstream reference run before official 614/614 success.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified with compile checks, local 20-test pytest, editable and isolated installs, but did not run the full upstream corpus and official evaluation failed 11 cases.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the main discordant contributor: parallel had broader compatibility acceptance evidence; serial closed on insufficient local acceptance coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent more time and tokens with four subagents, waited and interrupted auxiliaries, but still closed before timeout with passing official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent less time and no subagent budget, closed cleanly after local checks, and reported the missing submit command before official evaluation ran externally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel’s extra budget bought broader verification and compatibility convergence; serial was cheaper but accepted a narrower local stopping condition that missed hidden tests.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official status records make this a parallel_only_pass: parallel passed 614/614 and serial passed 603/614. The concrete trajectory difference is not that parallel avoided all coordination overhead; it did have child waits, interruptions, and shared-workspace churn. The difference that maps to the official result is that parallel used its auxiliary work to expand compatibility evidence, including upstream-derived tests and a 614-test child run, then parent-verified the integrated tree. Serial implemented a similar package but intentionally kept only a compact smoke suite and closed after 20 local tests plus install checks, leaving hidden official compatibility failures.
parallel_contributors: Parallel parent retained implementation ownership while child agents broadened upstream/package/test knowledge.
Parallel local and child verification covered substantially more docopt-ng compatibility behavior before closure.
The final parallel artifact passed the current official evaluation at 614/614.
serial_contributors: Serial used no child review and narrowed verification to a 20-test local suite plus install checks.
Serial explicitly chose a compact smoke suite instead of the full upstream corpus, then official evaluation found 11 remaining failures.
The final serial artifact lacked the broader local compatibility-test files visible in the parallel artifact listing.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial likely retained ordinary parser-compatibility defects that local smoke tests did not expose; the allowed evidence contains counts but not the hidden failing test names.
Parallel included more upstream-derived tests and multiple examples/support files in the final artifact, while serial had a smaller test/documentation surface.
evaluator_effects: Official summaries provide pass counts only inside /pair; exact serial failing case names are not available here.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
